Square Injection PP Cups: A Differentiation Play for Premium Tea Brands

Article Quick Facts

Caliber
92 mm square
Capacities
650 ml, 960 ml
Finishes
Clear or frosted
Material
Injection-molded PP

Why Shape Is a Branding Decision

In a crowded bubble tea market, most cups look the same: round, tapered and clear. A square cup breaks that pattern instantly. The injection-molded square format reads as premium and intentional, giving photo-driven brands a distinctive silhouette on shelves, in delivery bags and across social media.

Square Injection PP Cup Specifications

Our 92mm square injection PP series is available in these configurations.

ModelCaliberCapacityHeightBaseWeight
PP-92 Square92 mm650 ml140 mm65 mm28 g
PP-92 Square92 mm960 ml200 mm65 mm35 g

The Premium In-Hand Feel

Because these cups are injection-molded, they have a thick, rigid wall that feels closer to reusable drinkware than to thin disposable cups. That heft, combined with clear or frosted finishes, supports a higher price point and reinforces a premium brand story for signature drinks.

Planning for Square Cups Operationally

Square cups deliver standout branding, but plan the operational side early. Square formats use square-fit sealing rather than a standard round seal head, so confirm your sealing setup, and pair the cups with matching square-fit lids or sealing. Contact us to confirm the lid and sealing options for the square series.

Article FAQs

What capacities does the square cup come in?

Our 92mm square injection PP series runs 650ml and 960ml, in both clear and frosted finishes.

Do square cups work with standard sealing machines?

Square cups use square-fit sealing rather than a standard round seal head. Confirm your machine supports square-fit sealing before ordering.

Can I get a custom square cup shape or logo?

Yes. We support custom injection molds for exclusive shapes and embossed logos. Contact us with your design to discuss mold requirements.
